source: gpuwm-hex forecast history converted by rw_mpas_convert (gpuwm-hex export --field-set full --window region-latlon:CLAT,CLON,W_KM,H_KM or global-mesh) onto a regular lat-lon window
time_policy: decoded at every valid time and required invariant (the mesh terrain does not change)
member_policy: one hex run per input set; an ensemble member is its own run and its own frame set
vertical_policy: 55 MPAS model levels: full pressure in PB (P is zero), heights from the init zgrid in PHB (g = 9.80665) averaged to mass levels, theta from T + 300 K, temperature from theta with MPAS's own kappa (R/cp = 2/7) and p0 = 1e5 Pa
humidity_policy: QVAPOR and Q2 are dry-air mixing ratios; specific humidity is r / (1 + r), which initialization inverts exactly; condensate mixing ratios are carried as the run wrote them
wind_policy: RADAR_U_EARTH / RADAR_V_EARTH: earth-relative winds on the mass grid, the converter's full-field-set pair (no restaggering)
surface_policy: hex carries no ocean model: open-water skin temperature TSK is the SST the run was initialised with and is held, so SST is taken from TSK (water-skin-is-sst). Sea ice (SEAICE = xice) and snow (SNOW, SNOWH) are the land surface's own state from the history. Noah's four layers 0-10-40-100-200 cm map one to one.
input_identity: dynamic file paths and SHA-256 values are owned by the mapped input manifest
